tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Prepare Shop/UCP checkout only when asked. No separate spend request is needed. Use exact variant IDs/quantities. Share continue_url unchanged for Review and pay, including requires_escalation. Never recreate: get/update its ID. Address incomplete via update. Complete ready_for_complete only after buyer approval. Creates no order.

tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Find and compare offers by query/like. For an item found elsewhere without a usable ID or URL, search by brand and product name for a possible match, not proof of the same listing. Anonymous works; sign-in adds saved preferences. Context soft; filters hard. Matches/options do not prove the variant. Check messages; ground options, availability, price/currency, rating, seller, and URL in the exact offer. Use get_product only for missing facts/options. Amounts are minor units.

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: Look for matching offers using product/variant IDs, GTINs, UPCs, or public product URLs, including items found elsewhere. Match returned variant inputs to each identifier (exact versus featured); confirm seller and selected options before treating it as the same offer. A miss does not prove the original item unavailable. Use search_catalog for discovery or possible matches without a usable identifier; get_product only for missing facts. Preserve IDs/URLs; amounts are minor units.

tools.name: ask_business
tools.description: Ask shop a free-form question about its policies, services or facts it has published — returns, shipping thresholds, warranties, support hours — and get a plain-text answer. Read-only: nothing is created, changed or bought. Use catalog tools for what a product is or costs, location tools for stores, and the checkout or order for an order. One shop per call; include every detail in the question (no memory between calls).

query.description: The question, in the user's words, with every detail it depends on (which product, which country, which order).

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: Read signed-in Shop account, addresses, spend permissions, cards. For missing checkout delivery, copy one addresses[] entry unchanged into fulfillment destinations and select its id; preferred_address_id is default. buyer.email is display-only, never checkout input. Missing is unknown (messages say why); empty spend_permissions means none is set.

tools.name: create_spend_permission
tools.description: Create a spend permission: the buyer's approval, given ahead, for this agent to pay for purchases up to a limit. Optionally set a weekly or monthly period, one store and one saved card. Share the returned continue_url unchanged for the buyer to review and approve; the permission is pending until they do.

context.description: Buyer context. Provide what is known; intent is required.

intent.description: What this permission is for, in the buyer's words: what the agent may buy and why. Shown to the buyer when approving. 100-500 characters, with no URL, card number, email or address.

payment.description: Advertised handlers, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

types.description: Instrument types, most preferred first; ignore unknowns.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for approval_limit and per_purchase_limit. Currently limited to USD.

instrument_ids.description: Saved cards this permission may charge, each an id from get_account selectable_instruments[]. Omit to use get_account.preferred_instrument_id. Currently limited to one card.

per_purchase_limit.description: Limit for a single purchase in minor units of currency, no greater than approval_limit. Use it when the buyer wants to approve anything above an amount. Omit for no per-purchase limit.

period.description: How often approval_limit starts over. Omit for a limit that never starts over.

interval.description: ISO 8601 duration. Currently supported: P1W, one week starting Monday 00:00 UTC, and P1M, one month starting on the 1st at 00:00 UTC.

shops.description: Stores this permission is for, each a shop hostname as used on cart and checkout calls. Omit for every store. Currently limited to one store.

Provide the purchase terms and spending limit; name a saved card, or omit it to use the account's preferred card. Share the returned continue_url unchanged for review and approval. This does not pay or place an order.
